prerequisites: Existing uv and Git; source-specific compiler/system libraries and backend prerequisites from nstack show P262. This recipe selects CPU/basic package only; it installs no weights, provider extras, device driver, daemon or global tool. Build/submodule incompatibility fails closed.
lock_resolution: Fetch and check out only this exact commit in a private owned build prefix. Resolve explicit source build-system requirements to a hash lock, build one wheel without build isolation, verify its distribution metadata, resolve runtime dependencies to a second hash lock, sync with required hashes. Retain source/wheel/interpreter/uv identity and all environment file hashes. Repeat commissioning verifies the existing lock without resolving upgrades.
invoke: From a bounded project: nstack run P262 python -- /absolute/project/script.py [arguments]. Use only the registered package API, actual task inputs and current project permissions.
check: nstack check P262 python (actual import and distribution identity only). Then execute the distinct output, negative control and independent comparison from the component acceptance checks; import success is not domain acceptance.
deactivate: Each script exits normally; stop only a task-owned service started by that script after reconciling effects. nstack remove-runtime P262 python quarantines the exact owned environment and lock into private recovery. No global registration is created.
task_prerequisites: elevenlabs SDK, provider API key, explicit voice ID/model ID and pronunciation dictionary.
task_acceptance: Listen to names, numbers, language, pacing and full tail; compare requested text to ASR only as secondary signal.
User-owned script: names/numbers, language-switch, prosody and matched integrated level. Choose by blind listening and target latency/budget rather than size or popularity.
